# Milestone D Reference Fixtures

`milestone_d.json` is deterministic offline test data. Public company, country,
sector, commodity, and ticker names are included only as obvious reference
examples; `Skyway Airlines` and `Example Energy` are synthetic.

Every relationship magnitude, confidence, and mapping confidence is an
uncalibrated fixture engineering value chosen to verify formulas and historical
behavior. None is asserted to be current market truth or suitable for trading.
